name: BabiNgepet_07
summary: BabiNgepet_07 is a Martingale-based Expert Advisor that opens positions and doubles lot size after each consecutive loss, aiming to recover previous losses with a single winning trade. The EA uses a simple signal entry mechanism and relies on the Martingale progression rather than sophisticated technical analysis for profitability. It carries significant risk of account blow-up during prolonged losing streaks.
summary_zh: BabiNgepet_07是一个基于马丁格尔策略的EA，在每次连续亏损后加倍仓位大小，试图通过一次盈利交易来恢复之前的损失。该EA使用简单的信号入场机制，依赖马丁格尔递进而非精密的技术分析来获取利润。在持续亏损期间存在账户爆仓的重大风险。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于经典的马丁格尔倍仓法，每次交易亏损后将下一笔交易的手数翻倍，期望最终一次盈利能覆盖所有累计亏损并获利。入场条件通常依赖简单的技术指标信号或固定条件触发，初始仓位较小。出场条件为达到目标盈利时平仓，但止损设置可能不充分或依赖倍仓来弥补亏损而非严格止损。仓位管理完全依赖马丁格尔递进公式，没有最大倍仓层数限制或账户权益保护机制。资金管理方面，初始手数虽小，但连续亏损后手数呈指数增长，极易在5-6次连续亏损后耗尽账户保证金。整体策略缺乏对极端行情的防护，在单边趋势市场中可能快速爆仓。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is based on the classic Martingale doubling method, where the lot size is doubled after each losing trade, expecting that a single winning trade will recover all accumulated losses plus profit. Entry conditions rely on a simple technical signal or fixed condition trigger, starting with a small initial lot size. Exit conditions involve closing positions when a target profit is reached, but stop-loss may be inadequate or the EA relies on the doubling progression rather than strict stop-loss discipline. Position sizing is entirely governed by the Martingale progression formula, with no maximum layer limit or account equity protection mechanism. In terms of money management, although the initial lot is small, the lot size grows exponentially after consecutive losses, easily exhausting account margin after 5-6 consecutive losses. The overall strategy lacks protection against extreme market conditions and can blow up an account rapidly in a trending market.
pros: 中文优势1：初始仓位小，回撤在短期内可控
中文优势2：在震荡行情中表现良好，能通过倍仓快速回本
中文优势3：策略逻辑简单，易于理解和参数调整
pros_en: Small initial position size keeps drawdown manageable in the short term
Performs well in range-bound markets by recovering losses through doubling
Simple strategy logic makes it easy to understand and tune parameters
cons: 中文劣势1：马丁格尔策略存在账户爆仓的致命风险
中文劣势2：连续亏损后手数指数增长，保证金要求快速超出承受范围
中文劣势3：缺乏最大倍仓层数限制和账户权益保护机制
cons_en: Martingale strategy carries fatal risk of account blow-up during losing streaks
Exponential lot growth after consecutive losses quickly exceeds affordable margin requirements
Lacks maximum Martingale layer limit and account equity protection mechanisms
improvements: 中文改进1：增加最大倍仓层数限制，防止手数无限增长
中文改进2：加入账户权益回撤保护，当回撤超过阈值时停止交易
improvements_en: Add a maximum Martingale layer limit to prevent unlimited lot size growth
Implement account equity drawdown protection that halts trading when drawdown exceeds a threshold

risk_points: 中文风险点1：马丁格尔倍仓在持续亏损时手数指数增长，极易导致爆仓
中文风险点2：没有止损或止损设为0，单笔交易风险完全不可控
risk_points_en: Martingale doubling causes exponential lot growth during losing streaks,极易leading to account blow-up
No stop-loss or stop-loss set to 0 means single trade risk is completely uncontrolled
